name: China
note: China in the style of the Russian model tree: Party leadership as the historical path, a democratic transition led by a real party of the data (the China Democracy Party) and a junta as alternatives; economy (WTO, Western Development, the 2008 stimulus, high-speed rail, Made in China 2025), society (the one-, two- and three-child policies, hukou reform), military and foreign policy (Belt and Road). Sourced starting spirits in data/spirits/chn.json. Alternatives are a counterfactual.

source.title: Wikipedia: China and the World Trade Organization

focuses.name: The leading role of the Party
focuses.description: Whether the Party's rule continues as it is or changes.

focuses.name: Party leadership
focuses.description: The Communist Party leads the state, as it historically did.

focuses.name: The Three Represents
focuses.description: Admit new social groups to the Party. Jiang Zemin introduced the Three Represents on 25 February 2000.

focuses.name: Discipline in the Party
focuses.description: A campaign against corruption among officials.

focuses.name: Credit records
focuses.description: National credit records for companies and people.

focuses.name: A democracy movement
focuses.description: Liberal dissidents such as the China Democracy Party win a following in a crisis.

focuses.name: Free speech
focuses.description: Allow open debate and independent newspapers.

focuses.name: A democratic transition
focuses.description: The most popular liberal party forms a transitional government and calls free elections.

focuses.name: A federal China
focuses.description: Autonomy for the provinces and regions.

focuses.name: The army steps in
focuses.description: In a crisis the generals prepare to take over.

focuses.name: Military council
focuses.description: The army removes the government. The coup may fail.

focuses.name: Martial order
focuses.description: A state of emergency and military rule.

focuses.name: Reform and opening up
focuses.description: Continue the policy of reform and opening up.

focuses.name: Join the World Trade Organization
focuses.description: China joined the WTO on 11 December 2001 after lengthy negotiations.

focuses.name: State enterprise reform
focuses.description: Restructure loss-making state enterprises.

focuses.name: Western Development
focuses.description: Invest in the western provinces and regions to reduce the gap with the coast.

focuses.name: Coastal export zones
focuses.description: Expand export manufacturing on the coast.

focuses.name: Go Out
focuses.description: Encourage Chinese companies to invest abroad.

focuses.name: Three Gorges Dam
focuses.description: Finish the dam on the Yangtze, the largest power station in the world; the dam body was completed in 2006.

focuses.name: The 2008 stimulus
focuses.description: A stimulus of 4 trillion yuan against the global recession, announced on 9 November 2008.

focuses.name: High-speed rail
focuses.description: Build the world's longest high-speed rail network. Unlocks new lines.

focuses.name: Control local debt
focuses.description: Rein in borrowing by local governments.

focuses.name: Made in China 2025
focuses.description: An industrial plan, signed in May 2015, to move up from cheap manufacturing to high technology. Unlocks a state technology fund.

focuses.name: Electric vehicles
focuses.description: Subsidies for electric cars and batteries.

focuses.name: Domestic demand first
focuses.description: Rely more on domestic consumption and self-reliance.

focuses.name: Solar and wind
focuses.description: The largest solar and wind build-out in the world.

focuses.name: A moderately prosperous society
focuses.description: Health, schools and pensions for everyone.

focuses.name: Rural health insurance
focuses.description: Health insurance for the countryside.

focuses.name: Hukou reform
focuses.description: Let migrant workers register in the cities where they work.

focuses.name: Two-child policy
focuses.description: Allow two children per family, as from 2016.

focuses.name: Three-child policy
focuses.description: Allow three children per family, as from 2021.

focuses.name: World-class universities
focuses.description: Fund leading universities.

focuses.name: The Beijing Olympics
focuses.description: Host the Olympic Games in Beijing, 8 to 24 August 2008.

focuses.name: Space programme
focuses.description: Crewed flights, a space station and lunar probes.

focuses.name: Pensions for all
focuses.description: A basic pension for rural and urban residents.

focuses.name: Military modernisation
focuses.description: Shift the armed forces from numbers to technology.

focuses.name: A blue-water navy
focuses.description: Aircraft carriers, destroyers and submarines.

focuses.name: Missile forces
focuses.description: Expand the missile forces.

focuses.name: A modern air force
focuses.description: Stealth fighters and modern air bases.

focuses.name: Defence industry
focuses.description: Large state defence corporations.

focuses.name: Theatre commands
focuses.description: Reorganise the army into joint theatre commands.

focuses.name: Cyber and space forces
focuses.description: A force for cyber, space and electronic warfare.

focuses.name: Bases in the South China Sea
focuses.description: Build up reefs into bases.

focuses.name: An overseas base
focuses.description: A support base abroad for the navy.

focuses.name: Pressure on Taiwan
focuses.description: Large exercises around Taiwan and a claim on the island.

focuses.name: Foreign policy
focuses.description: China's place in the world.

focuses.name: Good neighbours
focuses.description: Settle borders and expand trade with the neighbours.

focuses.name: Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
focuses.description: Security cooperation with Russia and Central Asia.

focuses.name: China and Africa
focuses.description: Loans, trade and infrastructure in Africa.

focuses.name: Belt and Road Initiative

focuses.name: Partnership with Russia
focuses.description: Energy, arms and diplomacy with Russia.

focuses.name: An Asian development bank
focuses.description: A new development bank for Asia's infrastructure.

focuses.name: Global initiatives
focuses.description: Development and security initiatives for the Global South.

focuses.name: Answer the trade war
focuses.description: Tariffs and controls in response to US tariffs.

focuses.name: The Pearl River Delta
focuses.description: Factories and ports around Guangzhou and Shenzhen.

focuses.name: The Yangtze Delta
focuses.description: Industry and finance around Shanghai.

focuses.name: Revive the north-east
focuses.description: Restructure the old industrial base of the north-east.

focuses.name: The rise of central China
focuses.description: Investment in the central provinces.

focuses.name: Coal power
focuses.description: Build coal power plants to meet demand.

focuses.name: Nuclear power
focuses.description: A large programme of nuclear reactors.

focuses.name: Semiconductors
focuses.description: A national effort to make advanced chips.

focuses.name: Artificial intelligence
focuses.description: A national plan for artificial intelligence.

focuses.name: Digital payments
focuses.description: Mobile payments and a digital currency.

focuses.name: Financial reform
focuses.description: Open the capital markets step by step.

focuses.name: Grain security
focuses.description: Protect farmland and grain output.

focuses.name: End extreme poverty

focuses.name: New urbanisation

focuses.name: Clean air

focuses.name: An ageing society
focuses.description: Pensions and care for the elderly.

focuses.name: Hong Kong and Macau
focuses.description: Integrate Hong Kong and Macau with the Greater Bay Area.

focuses.name: Development of the western regions
focuses.description: Railways and investment in Tibet and Xinjiang.

focuses.name: Aircraft carriers

focuses.name: Amphibious forces
focuses.description: Landing ships and marines.

focuses.name: Hypersonic missiles
focuses.description: Hypersonic glide vehicles.

focuses.name: Military drones
focuses.description: Drones for all services.

focuses.name: A professional army

focuses.name: Trade with Europe
focuses.description: Freight trains and investment in Europe.

focuses.name: Partners in Latin America
focuses.description: Trade and loans in Latin America.

focuses.name: Emerging economies
